principle: Explicit redistribution evidence is required before Civweave labels media mesh-redistributable.

provider_rules.wikimedia-commons: Require Commons machine-readable metadata matching the conservative allowlist.
provider_rules.peertube: Require PeerTube licence id 1, 2, 7, or 8. Mesh caching additionally requires downloadEnabled and a provider file URL.
provider_rules.internet-archive: Require explicit item licenseurl matching CC0/Public Domain/CC BY/CC BY-SA and a downloadable video file.

hashing: SHA-256 is computed by the node when a media binary enters local cache; provider hashes are retained as provenance hints.
youtube: YouTube audiovisual binaries remain LINK_ONLY and are not harvested into this redistributable cache.
